item.title: dotnet: How Uno Platform uses .NET, MCP, and AI to build high quality apps
item.description:
Uno Platform built two MCP servers in C# to let AI agents use real documentation as context and interact with a running cross-platform .NET app. The post describes how .NET, MCP, and AI are combined to support app development and validation.

item.title: dotnet: From dotnet run to Foundry Hosted Agent in 3 lines of C#
item.description:
Microsoft says an agent built with Microsoft Agent Framework can be deployed to Foundry Hosted Agent with 1 NuGet package, 3 lines of C#, and 2 commands.

item.title: dotnet: Beyond Chat: live Speech-to-Text with Foundry Local and C#
item.description:
The post shows how to build a live speech-to-text app in C# using Foundry Local and a compact Nemotron model. It also covers local model lifecycle management.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Announcing v2.0 of the official MCP C# SDK
item.description:
The official MCP C# SDK v2.0 now implements the 2026-07-28 MCP specification. It adds a stateless-first protocol, standardized HTTP headers, and Multi Round-Trip Requests for interactive tools while remaining backward compatible.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: Announcing: Multi-agent orchestration SDK with the Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework in C# and Python
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry has introduced Agent Framework, a unified multi-agent orchestration SDK for C# and Python. It consolidates orchestration patterns previously split across AutoGen and Semantic Kernel into a single set of abstractions.

  • Source: Azure Updates
